components.text: The [color=yellow]Laboratory[color] is where you study the [color=purple]parasite infection[color] and develop a cure.

It offers two functions : [br] - [color=cyan]Research[color] a pathogen sample captured from a [ref=stellaris:mobs/parasite]Lunar Parasite[ref]. [br] - Produce a [ref=stellaris:items/vaccine]Vaccine[ref] once your research is complete. [br] [br] The vaccine cures the infection and protects you from re-infection. [br] [br]
